message: HOLY COW, Leon, you got some NERVE and I love it! Cam Ward's got a cannon and Michael Wilson's a nice little piece, but Bijan Robinson just dropped THIRTY-FOUR POINTS on the league last week and he's wearin' Holy Cow Backfield colors, baby, that is not leaving this roster for a backup arm and a WR3! Tell you what though -- you clearly want him bad, which tells me everything I need to know about how good he is, so no hard feelins, no grudges, we're still pals, but the answer's a great big NO. Go Bijan, go home with that one, folks!
